description: A metadata index for any audio file: content-type guess (voice/music/mixed/noise/silence/unknown) with confidence, brightness & dynamics buckets, a rough band label, clipping/silence regions, and tag suggestions. For triage or auto-tagging a library. Status: content type, regions and confidence come from a frame classifier that is a proxy, not validated on a labelled corpus of real recordings; the tags describe the signal only, never the speaker (https://audiolab.tools/lenses). Set bandLimit:true to ask whether the audio was upsampled: bandLimit.upsampled is yes, no or cannot-say, with the reason in plain words. yes rests on a validated rule (study UP-1: the band stops under 5 kHz in a file of 16 kHz or more, as after a telephone call); no and the bandwidth ratio are proxies (study UP-2); cannot-say means look at the file, not that it is fine. The answer carries measureStatus: per field its status (validated, proxy, beta, withdrawn), basis and margin where known. Report a proxy as an approximation, never present a withdrawn field as what its name says, and stay inside a stated margin (https://audiolab.tools/docs/start/read-a-response#the-five-statuses). Audio source: a public https URL, or a local file path (`path`).

bandLimit.description: Also return bandLimit: whether the audio was upsampled (yes, no or cannot-say), its status, reason and basis. Off by default.

contentModel.description: Content-type model: v1 (the default until 15 January 2027) or v2 (the newer small learned model).

measureStatus.description: Add measureStatus to the answer: the status of each field. On by default; set false to leave it out.

path.description: Path to a LOCAL audio file on this machine. It is read here and uploaded to the AudioLab API for measuring, so you do not need to host it publicly (files up to 4 MB go in the request body; larger ones, up to 150 MB, upload over a signed URL and are swept from storage within the hour). Provide exactly one of url or path.

round.description: Round numbers to what they are worth (dB and LUFS 2 decimals, seconds 3, ms 1, Hz 1, shares 3); same keys and types. On by default; set false for full precision.

series.description: Include the curves and arrays (a large payload). Off by default.

url.description: Public https URL to the audio file. Provide exactly one of url or path.

name: index_signal
title: Index a signal (SignalLab)
